video_title: Halo Campaign Evolved on ROG Xbox Ally X!
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies GameSir as a sponsor of ETA PRIME's July 2026 video 'Halo Campaign Evolved on ROG Xbox Ally X!'. ETA PRIME's exact July 30, 2026 YouTube upload was independently identified through a third-party article embedding the video. GameSir sells tangible gaming controllers and mobile gaming hardware. GameSir's official corporate page lists Leon at leon@gamesir.com for overseas market cooperation, including marketing, promotion, influencer, and gaming cooperation.
